_why: Paths (dotted, list indexes as numbers) that may differ from the decision corpus, per golden (synthetic/<decision>.<family> or existing/<test file stem>). A split of _relay_draft or _evaluate_tool_call that changes no decision names nothing here; a reviewed behaviour change names each path it moves, and the list is cleared once it merges. This change (2026-11-19): step 5a of the relay holds a reply that leaves out, alters or repeats a fixed sentence a tool answered this turn (say_other_words holds, say_matched passes, say_none_beside_a_say: a "none" beside a real say is decided by the real say), and tier 1 holds a reply to a firm address that names the machinery on any turn (mechanics_named); the pairs and raises generated from those cases. No existing record moves.
